name: Zynaps: gamevars
summary: The game variables: the play passes, the scroll, the sound, the current player.

labels.name: PassCount
labels.comment: +1 each play pass (PlayInterrupt $AA03); bit 0 = an odd pass

labels.name: PassBit
labels.comment: Rotated left each pass ($AA0A): AND an object's bit +$24 picks the objects that act this pass

labels.name: PassDepth
labels.comment: +1 on the entry of PlayInterrupt, -1 at its end: 1 = not nested

labels.name: PassPhase
labels.comment: The play pass phase 1-4 then 0; 4 on entry: the pass is skipped ($A9FB)

labels.name: ChainStep
labels.comment: The drawing chain's current step: $AAE5, +5 each phase (PlayChain $AACC)

labels.name: NodeFreeList
labels.comment: The head of the span node free list (pool $F800; LevelSetUp $8C3E)

labels.name: ShiftPage
labels.comment: The glyph cache page of the fine scroll phase: $C0 $C8 $D8 $D0 (a Gray code)

labels.name: FineScrollToggle
labels.comment: $08 or $10, XORed into ShiftPage by ScrollControl $A9D2

labels.name: ScrollThisPass
labels.comment: $FF when the pass scrolls one fine step, 0 when not; PathOpScroll $9640 tests bit 0

labels.name: TileSet
labels.comment: The tile set pointer $5C00 of BuildGlyph $89C9 (L replaced by the tile)

labels.name: RowsLeft
labels.comment: The renderer's row counter, 18 down to 0 (DrawPlayfield $85CA)

labels.name: EmptyRows
labels.comment: Rows without nodes counted by the scroll step ($8AED)

labels.name: RandomSeed
labels.comment: The five bytes of the random number generator (Random $8544, seeded by $8516)

labels.name: SkipDraw
labels.comment: Bit 0 set: DrawGroup places nothing (the catch-up loop $AF6B)

labels.name: PanelBurst
labels.comment: Set to 6 by FireLaser $9C1D when 0; the panel ($AB13) counts it down, a pair of cells moving out

labels.name: SpinnerFrame
labels.comment: The panel spinners' frame 0-15, +1 each odd pass ($AB13)

labels.name: SpinnerColour
labels.comment: The spinners' ink, + SpinnerColourStep each odd pass, bouncing between 1 and 7

labels.name: DeathTimer
labels.comment: $FF while the ship lives; $16 at its death, counted down (PlayerDying); not $FF stops the scroll and the level script

labels.name: EndPending
labels.comment: The end of play asked for: 1 a life lost, 2 the level done (script op 5), 4 abort

labels.name: EndCode
labels.comment: EndPending moved here by $ABD5: ends the play loop ($B1E9)

labels.name: RowBeep
labels.comment: The beeper bit toggled XOR $18 per playfield row (the engine hum)

labels.name: RowBeepMask
labels.comment: Its AND mask: the bit shifted out of SoundPattern1 each pass ($AA30)

labels.name: SoundPattern1
labels.comment: A 16-bit pattern shifted left each pass; $FD00 for an explosion (StartExplosion $A293)

labels.name: ObjectBeep
labels.comment: The beeper bit toggled per object strip ($8F9B)

labels.name: ObjectBeepMask
labels.comment: Its mask: the bit of SoundPattern2 ($AA3B)

labels.name: SoundPattern2
labels.comment: $EDB2 for an explosion

labels.name: SlotBeep
labels.comment: The beeper bit toggled per object slot (RunObjects $9463)

labels.name: SlotBeepMask
labels.comment: Its mask: the bit of SoundPattern3 ($AA46)

labels.name: SoundPattern3
labels.comment: $D6ED for an explosion

labels.name: EffectState
labels.comment: The playing effect's +0-+6 (EffectPlay $B30C), stepped by $B379

labels.name: SegLenA
labels.comment: The effect's segment length A (the low nibble of +7)

labels.name: SegLenB
labels.comment: Segment length B (the high nibble)

labels.name: PitchA
labels.comment: The effect's pitch A

labels.name: PitchB
labels.comment: Pitch B

labels.name: EffectFrames
labels.comment: The frames left in the segment

labels.name: EffectTick
labels.comment: $80 from the title interrupt $A9E4 and a new effect request, $FF from PlayInterrupt

labels.name: CurrentEffect
labels.comment: The effect playing (0 none, $80 stop); a request lower than it is refused (RequestEffect $B2F0)

labels.name: CurrentPlayer
labels.comment: 1 or 2 (AddScore $A495, PrintPlayerScore $A4BF; XOR 3 at the change, $B16D)

labels.name: PlayerRecord
labels.comment: The current player's record: $7F9C or $7FCC (10 readers in c1/c2)

labels.name: Players
labels.comment: 1 or 2 (SelectPlayers $A790; ChangePlayer $B149)
